name: headbutt-discard-to-draw-seed0
description: Headbutt's discard-to-top-of-draw card-choice cycle. Play Defend first (lands in discard), then Headbutt (damages enemy + raises pending_choice over the discard pile), then resolve_choice index=0 to put the discarded Defend on top of the draw pile. Mirrors sts2-rl-agent@01c094d:sts2_env/cards/ironclad.py:359-370.

compare.exclude_fields_reason: Cross-language RNG (Python MT vs Rust Xoshiro256++) — Cultist's intent roll diverges by design (monsters.rs:22-29). Headbutt + resolve_choice itself does not consume RNG so pile shapes stay byte-equal.
